required_stages.description: Per-row max over the class axis and sum of exp(logit - max), fp32, from one logical traversal of the row (whole-row tile with non-contributing padding, or chunked online update).
Gather of the target logit logits[i, targets[i]] (re-read or selected from the loaded row).
loss[i] = -(target_logit - max - log(sum)) rounded once to logits.dtype and stored; no global intermediate (statistics, shifted logits, probabilities stay on chip).

forbidden_substitutions.message: library cross-entropy replaces the whole computation
library log-sum-exp/softmax replaces the row reduction
host-side gather of the target logit
host-side reduction or transcendental on tensors
a zero-filled or extra buffer suggests a materialised intermediate; no global scratch is permitted

required_evidence.message: fp32 conversion of the row before the reductions

outputs.aliasing: none; a freshly allocated (batch_size,) tensor in logits.dtype on every call

timing_boundary.notes: Measured: GPU time of all device work run() causes (the loss kernel); the output allocation call and host scalar arithmetic are host work, not GPU time. No casts, copies or transposes are permitted; a .contiguous() on logits must be a no-op. No state across calls.
